raw:
The common room is quieter than it was after dinner. Rashid sits at a study table near the fire with tomorrow’s seminar papers spread in a precise stack, but he looks up when you enter.

“How’d your evening go?” you ask.

He leans back slightly. “Ashara made me regret every shortcut I’ve ever taken with my footwork. Then I arrived late to cards, lost twice, and Dena made sure I understood that being apologetic doesn’t improve a hand.”

A small smile catches at one corner of his mouth.

“So: productive, apparently.”
